cookie.prep: Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
cookie.cook: Scoop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the sheets, about 5 cm (2 in) apart. Bake one sheet at a time at {temp} for {time}, until the edges are set and lightly golden.
cookie.check: The edges should be golden and the centers just set. They look a little soft but firm up as the cookies cool.
notes: Bake one tray at a time on the middle rack for even browning.
Cookies keep cooking on the hot tray, so let them rest for 5 minutes before moving them.

cookie.prep: Line the basket with perforated air fryer parchment (or lightly grease it). Never put loose parchment into a preheated air fryer without food on top to hold it down.
cookie.cook: Place 3-4 slightly flattened scoops of dough in the basket, well apart because they spread. Air fry at {temp} for {time}, until the edges are golden.
cookie.check: The edges should be set and golden. The centers can look slightly soft - they firm up as the cookies cool.
notes: Air fryer batches are small, so expect several rounds - the time per batch stays the same.
Flatten the dough balls slightly so they cook through evenly.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Classic cookies with crisp edges, soft centers and plenty of chocolate.

yield.note: Medium cookies from about 1 1/2 tablespoons of dough each.

less.note: Sugar also controls how much cookies spread and brown, so the reduction for this recipe is a modest 20%.
expectedChanges: Cookies may spread a little less
May brown slightly less and feel a bit more cake-like

steps.title: Cream {^butter|Butter} and Sugars
steps.text: Beat the {@butter|softened butter} with the sugars until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add {L|^egg|Eggs;^vanilla_extract|Vanilla}
steps.text: Beat in the {L|#egg|eggs;#vanilla_extract|vanilla} until smooth.

steps.title: Mix Dry Ingredients
steps.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the {L|=flour;#baking_soda|baking soda;=salt}.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add the dry ingredients to the {#butter|butter} mixture and mix on low speed until just combined. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Chill the Dough
steps.text: Cover and chill the dough for 30 minutes so it is easy to scoop and the cookies keep their shape.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then move them to a wire rack.

tips: Chilling the dough for 30 minutes gives thicker, chewier cookies.
@butter: Use room-temperature (not melted) butter for the best texture.
Pull the cookies out when the centers still look slightly soft - they finish on the tray.

yield.note: Medium cookies from about 1 1/2 tablespoons of dough each.

less.note: Sugar cookies depend on sugar for spread, crisp edges and tenderness, so the reduction is small - about 15%.

Edges may be a bit less crisp

recipes.description: Chewy, hearty cookies with warm cinnamon.

yield.note: Medium cookies from about 1 1/2 tablespoons of dough each.

less.note: Oatmeal cookies are already a little less sweet than most, so a 20% reduction works well.
expectedChanges: Cookies may spread a little less
Slightly paler color and a more oaty flavor

yield.note: Medium cookies from about 1 1/2 tablespoons of dough each.

less.note: Sugar controls spread and tenderness in these cookies, so the reduction is a modest 20%.
expectedChanges: Cookies may spread a little less
Slightly less browned, with a stronger peanut flavor

steps.text: Beat the {@butter|softened butter} with the sugars until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add {L|^egg|Eggs;^vanilla_extract|Vanilla}
steps.text: Beat in the {L|=peanut butter;#egg|eggs;#vanilla_extract|vanilla} until smooth.

steps.title: Mix Dry Ingredients
steps.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the {L|=flour;#baking_soda|baking soda;=salt}.
